standard_prerequisites.name: The notation of the blowup and the distinguished triangle attached to it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms, label more-morphisms-lemma-blowup (cited at statement line 3189) and Same chapter derham.tex, label lemma-distinguished-triangle-blowup (invoked at proof line 3196)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first fixes the blowup diagram $b : X' \to X$, $i : Z \to X$, $p : E \to Z$; the second supplies the triangle in the derived category of $(X \to S)^{-1}\mathcal{O}_S$-modules from which the two summands below arise.

standard_prerequisites.name: Splitting criterion in a triangulated category
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, label derived-lemma-split (invoked at proof line 3203)
standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that a splitting of the map on the two summands whose image contains the summand $i_*\Omega^\bullet_{Z/S}$ yields a splitting of the first arrow of the triangle which vanishes on that summand.

standard_prerequisites.name: Decomposition into components of fixed relative dimension, and regularity of the closed immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free (invoked at proof line 3214) and Divisors, label divisors-lemma-immersion-smooth-into-smooth-regular-immersion (invoked at proof line 3221)
standard_prerequisites.use: They reduce to $X$ smooth of a fixed relative dimension $N$ and show that each $i_m : Z_m \to X$ is a regular immersion of codimension $N - m$, so that the projective bundle formula applies to $E_m \to Z_m$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The projective space bundle formula and the description of its summands
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, remark remark-projective-space-bundle-formula (invoked at proof lines 3235, 3251 and 3282)
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the isomorphism $\tilde\xi$ identifying $Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{E/S}$ with a direct sum of shifts of $\Omega^\bullet_{Z/S}$, together with the subcomplexes $M_m$ and $K_m$ satisfying $M = K[-2]$ and the commutativity of the diagram involving $\theta'$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Gysin-type map of the blowup and its relation to the first Chern class of the exceptional line bundle
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, label lemma-gysin-via-log-complex (invoked at proof line 3273) and remark remark-cup-product-as-a-map (invoked at proof line 3280)
standard_prerequisites.use: They provide the map $\delta : \Omega^\bullet_{E/S}[-2] \to \Omega^\bullet_{X'/S}$ whose composite with the restriction back to $E$ is $\theta'$ for $c_1^{dR}(\mathcal{O}_E(1))$, which is what makes the displayed chain a section.

core_obligations: Reduce the claim to a splitting of the map $Rb_*\Omega^\bullet_{X'/S} \oplus i_*\Omega^\bullet_{Z/S} \to i_*Rp_*\Omega^\bullet_{E/S}$ whose image contains the summand $i_*\Omega^\bullet_{Z/S}$, which by the splitting criterion in the derived category gives the proposition (proof lines 3195-3209).

Decompose $X$ into open and closed pieces of fixed relative dimension $N$ and $Z$ into pieces $Z_m$ of relative dimension $m$, so that $i_m$ is a regular immersion of codimension $N - m$ and the projective bundle formula can be applied to $E_m = p^{-1}(Z_m) \to Z_m$ (proof lines 3212-3224).

Use the bundle formula to obtain the isomorphism $\tilde\xi$ from the direct sum of shifts $\Omega^\bullet_{Z_m/S}[-2t]$ for $t = 0, \ldots, N-m-1$ onto $Rp_{m,*}\Omega^\bullet_{E_m/S}$, whose degree zero part is the canonical map, and assemble the subcomplexes $M$ and $K$ with $M = K[-2]$ and $c_{E/Z} \oplus \tilde\xi|_M$ an isomorphism (proof lines 3224-3265).

Introduce the map $\delta : \Omega^\bullet_{E/S}[-2] \to \Omega^\bullet_{X'/S}$ whose composite back to $\Omega^\bullet_{E/S}$ is the map $\theta'$ attached to $c_1^{dR}(\mathcal{O}_E(1))$, and record the commutative diagram relating $\theta'$, $\tilde\xi|_K$ and $\tilde\xi|_M$ (proof lines 3267-3291).

Write down the four-step composite defining the splitting of the claim and conclude from the relation between $\theta'$ and $\delta$ and the commutativity above that it is a section of the canonical map, completing the proof (proof lines 3292-3310).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the claim about the two summands (proof lines 3195-3209).
Decomposition into fixed relative dimensions and regularity of the immersions (proof lines 3212-3224).
The map $\delta$ and its relation to $\theta'$ (proof lines 3267-3291).
The explicit section and the conclusion (proof lines 3292-3310).
difficulty_reason: The proposition shows that the de Rham complex of a blowup admits the de Rham complex of the base as a direct summand, a splitting statement that is one of the structural inputs to the de Rham theory of blowups (statement lines 3187-3192). The proof reduces to exhibiting a section of a map between the two summands of the blowup triangle, decomposes the situation into pieces of fixed relative dimension so that the projective bundle formula for the exceptional divisor applies, produces the isomorphism $\tilde\xi$ together with the subcomplexes $M$ and $K$, and then constructs the section explicitly out of the Gysin-type map $\delta$ whose composite with restriction is the Chern class map. The construction and verification of the explicit section is the substance, so the claim is H3.
